company.name: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
company.shortDescription: ADNOC is active in onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration through providing drilling services and supporting marine equipment.
company.description:
Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) was to operate in all areas of the oil and gas industry and since then has steadily broadened its activity in establishing companies and subsidiaries and creating an integrated oil and gas industry in the fields of exploration and production, support services, oil refining and gas processing, chemicals and petrochemicals, maritime transportation and refined products and distribution.

ADNOC Drilling Company PJSC provides drilling services and associated marine equipment, as well as the hiring out of onshore and offshore drilling rigs on behalf of connected parties engaging in onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration. Onshore, Offshore Jack-up, Offshore Island, and OilField Service are the operating business segments, with Onshore generating the most revenue.

aiResearchSummary.text: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company is advancing subsurface characterization and reservoir engineering through work on a Method of detection of hydrocarbon horizontal slippage passages and Muon based imaging and detection of fluids, gases and natural solids. It pursues reservoir stimulation using a Limited entry liner for hydrocarbon reservoir stimulation with deep penetration and a Method for determining an outlet configuration of a liner, and improves planning via a System for recommending a reservoir monitoring plan and flow testing plan of wells, covering detection, imaging, stimulation and monitoring.
